lumi.name: Lab Club Lumi (intl)
lumi.description: Young female cartoon character voice for an international kids' science show, neutral English accent. Gentle, youthful and soft like a children's storyteller, warm and clear, but calm, composed and clever: mid pitch, unhurried, controlled, never shrill. A friendly young genius girl who explains things. Studio quality, close mic.

zuzu.name: Lab Club Zuzu (intl)
zuzu.description: Young female cartoon character voice for an international kids' science show, neutral American English. High-pitched, bubbly and giggly, very energetic and loud, slightly squeaky, big exaggerated cartoon reactions, clumsy and lovable underdog. Like a cheerful animated sidekick who always gets launched across the room. Studio quality.

anna.name: Lab Club Anna (intl)
anna.description: Young female cartoon character voice for an international kids' science show, neutral American English. Bright, sassy and confident, a bit bossy and smug, theatrical and proud, clear and assertive, medium-high pitch. A self-appointed club leader who is sure she is always right. Studio quality.

miyu.name: Lab Club Miyu (intl)
miyu.description: Young female cartoon character voice for an international kids' science show, neutral English. Very quiet, soft and breathy, sleepy and slow, drowsy half-whisper, low energy but cute and gentle. A sleepy cat-like girl who has just woken up. Studio quality, close mic.
